overall_assessment: The sampled current plans are generally readable and complete, and all eight random controls match their course codes. Eight of nine dup_code suspects show the expected base-code plan shared across offering variants, while BTM1003-1 receives the RLE1003N plan. Two Greek courses retain a read-more control label, and all three separately reviewed failed rows have plausible course URLs.

findings.description: The page fetched for BTM1003-1 (Kristen tro og etikk) at /emne/btm1003-2 identifies itself as RLE1003N (Kristen tro, etikk og livstolkning) and describes a web-based course. The build accepts that other course's full plan.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: resolve_urls_fjellhaug_batch() in R/resolve_course_urls.R matches the first sitemap URL by slug prefix. That prefix can match BTM1003 even when the fetched facts box declares a different course code.
findings.suggested_fix: Check the fetched Fjellhaug facts-box code against the normalized offering code, allowing explicitly verified aliases. On mismatch, try the remaining sitemap candidates for that base code and attach a plan only after the displayed code matches.

findings.description: A standalone read-more control label interrupts the course description in both Greek plans. The expandable plan text and assigned passages are present.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Fjellhaug's main#main selection includes the inline disclosure trigger, which the existing breadcrumb, navigation and mobile-copy exclusions miss.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a Fjellhaug DOM exclusion scoped to the disclosure trigger with normalized label Les mer. Keep the associated content panel and verify that its text and passage list still extract.
